# Awesome Handmade

> 100% Handcrafted Indian Heritage Craft, Traditional Jewellery, Bridal Latkans, and Cholis from Surat, Gujarat.

Awesome Handmade is an Indian artisanal storefront offering genuine handcrafted bridal latkans, Gujarati cholis, traditional jewellery, hair accessories, and custom festival hampers.

## Primary Sections & Collections
- [Shop Catalog](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/shop): Browse all handcrafted products
- [Bridal Latkans](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/shop?category=Latkan): Traditional Gujarati wedding latkans and tassels
- [Handmade Cholis](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/shop?category=Choli): Authentic Navratri and wedding designer wear
- [Heritage Jewellery](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/shop?category=Jewellery): Handcrafted necklaces, earrings, and bangles
- [Hair Accessories](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/shop?category=Hair_Accessories): Handcrafted clips, scrunchies, and bands
- [Contact & Bespoke Orders](https://www.awesomehandmade.com/contact): Reach out for personalized craftsmanship
